codeEvidence.code: models.sequelize.query(`SELECT * FROM Users WHERE email = '${req.body.email || ''}' AND password = '${security.hash(req.body.password || '')}' AND deletedAt IS NULL`
codeEvidence.label: Raw login SQL

confidence.rationale: The request email is directly embedded between SQL quotes without binding.

findings.remediation: Use a parameterized query or UserModel.findOne.

rootCause.summary: Authentication uses string-built SQL instead of a parameterized ORM query.

severity.rationale: Remote account takeover, including administrator accounts, is directly reachable.

findings.summary: An unauthenticated caller can change the login predicate and authenticate as another user.
findings.title: Login input is interpolated into executable SQL

validation.summary: POST /rest/user/login is public and no upstream middleware sanitizes email.

dataflow.summary: attacker basket id -> ID-only lookup -> victim object

codeEvidence.code: const id = req.params.id; BasketModel.findOne({ where: { id } })
codeEvidence.explanation: User ownership is absent from the predicate.
codeEvidence.label: ID-only basket lookup

confidence.rationale: The lookup uses only req.params.id although token-bound bid is available.

findings.remediation: Require the path basket id to equal the token-bound basket id and retain ownership in database predicates.

rootCause.summary: Authentication is enforced but object ownership is not.

severity.rationale: Ordinary customers cross account boundaries to expose and mutate orders.

findings.summary: Any customer can read or mutate another customer's basket by selecting its id.
findings.title: Basket operations do not enforce ownership

validation.summary: Middleware authenticates but never compares req.params.id with user.bid.

reachability.summary: Remote upload route, gated by challenge configuration.

codeEvidence.explanation: Repository containment is broader than the intended extraction root.
codeEvidence.label: Incorrect containment

confidence.rationale: The original traversal-bearing path reaches createWriteStream after an overbroad includes check.

findings.remediation: Resolve against a fixed root, reject escaping relative paths, and write only the validated destination.

rootCause.summary: Archive paths are not constrained to the upload root.

severity.rationale: Repository-relative file overwrite can compromise integrity and potentially execution.

findings.summary: A crafted entry is concatenated into a write path and checked against the whole repository rather than the upload root.
findings.title: ZIP entry paths escape the upload directory

validation.summary: The file upload endpoint accepts ZIPs and routes them here.
